nodes.name: code.mdx
nodes.summary: Mintlify documentation page demonstrating inline code and fenced code blocks, including language-tagged syntax highlighting and optional file names after the language identifier.

nodes.name: images.mdx
nodes.summary: Mintlify documentation page covering images and embeds: markdown image syntax with size limits, HTML img embeds for customizability, general HTML element support, and iFrame embedding for videos.

nodes.name: markdown.mdx
nodes.summary: Mintlify documentation page serving as a markdown syntax reference: titles and subtitles with anchors, text formatting (bold, italic, strikethrough, super/subscript), root-relative page links, blockquotes, and LaTeX components.

nodes.name: navigation.mdx
nodes.summary: Mintlify documentation page explaining the navigation field of docs.json: recursive tab/group/page structure, folder-based routing for nested URLs, the reserved top-level api folder name, and hidden pages excluded from the sidebar.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses the Mintlify CodeGroup MDX component to present paired JSON examples (regular vs nested navigation) of the recursive navigation schema.

nodes.name: reusable-snippets.mdx
nodes.summary: Mintlify documentation page on authoring reusable MDX snippets: default-export content snippets with prop-driven variables, exported reusable variables, and arrow-function components imported from the snippets directory, which is excluded from standalone page rendering.

nodes.name: settings.mdx
nodes.summary: Mintlify documentation page providing the full reference for global docs.json settings: name, navigation, logo/favicon, colors, topbar links and CTA button, versions, anchors, tabs, API auth/playground configuration, OpenAPI file paths, footer socials, feedback buttons, and the dark-mode toggle.
nodes.languageNotes: Renders the entire settings schema through Mintlify MDX components (ResponseField, Expandable, CodeGroup) instead of tables, nesting expandable field definitions up to four levels deep for the api and colors objects.
